newsitem.title: PERU: Peru state fishing firm sells off two units.
newsitem.headline: Peru state fishing firm sells off two units.

text.p: Peru's state fishing company Pescaperu sold two plants Thursday to local companies for a total of $6.7 million, privatization officials said.
Peruvian fishing company Nemesis won the auction for the Chancay fishmeal plant with an offer of $5.75 million, $1.3 million higher than the minimum bid price required at the auction.
Another fishing company, Parmaso Construcciones, bought the Callao refinery for $951,000, which was $800,000 higher than the minimum bid price.
With these sales, we have raised about $70 million so far through the privatizations of Pescaperu units,_ said Dante Matellini, head of the company's privatization board.
He added that the next sales in the piecemeal sell-off of Pescaperu, which is now more than half completed, would be the factories of Chimbote, Huarmey, Huacho and Callao on December 20.
